Constitutional status to urban local bodies

items: The 74th Amendment Act pertains to Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), whereas the 73rd Amendment pertains to Panchayati Raj Institutions.
Questions frequently test the fixed tenure provision (5 years) and the mandatory reservation requirements for women and SC/ST candidates.
Both the State Election Commission (for elections) and State Finance Commission (for financial devolution) are key institutional mechanisms mandated by this amendment.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The 74th Amendment accords constitutional status to Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
It guarantees a mandatory fixed tenure of 5 years for municipalities.
It ensures political representation through reservations for SC, ST, and women.
It provides for the establishment of independent constitutional authorities: State Election Commission and State Finance Commission.
It introduces Ward Committees to facilitate local governance within municipalities.
